title: Map native macOS feasibility on Intel and Apple Silicon
objective: Use XCL source and public Apple documentation to map the loader, ABI, executable-memory and graphics constraints. Propose the smallest synthetic milestone for a native macOS host.
acceptance: Distinguish an Intel macOS process executing x86-64 code from an arm64 macOS process that needs guest CPU translation
Record known constraints and unresolved questions with source links; do not claim support for either configuration
Specify a synthetic host test and separate what it proves from a future graphics or retail test
